RECITALS: AK Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 110 East 128th Street, New York, New York, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A (Legal Description), annexed hereto (the “Property"). The Property is identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York ("Tax Map") as Block 1775, Lots 168 and 165 (Block 1775, Lot 168, hereinafter referred to as “Lot 168"; Block 1775, Lot 165, hereinafter referred to as “Lot 165"). Lot 168 and Lot 165 are each Finance and will result in each tax lot, Lot 168 and Lot 165 taking on the separate metes and bounds described in Exhibit A (Legal Description).The Property is owned by the AK Owner (AK Owner, as owner of Lot 168, hereinafter referred to as “Developer"; AK Owner, as owner of Lot 165, hereinafter referred to as “Owner"; Lot 168 with buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as "Developer's Building"; Lot 165 with buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as "Owner's Building"; and Lot 165 and Owner's Building, collectively, "Owner's Parcel"). Owner's Building was developed pursuant to the Harlem-East Harlem Urban Renewal Plan (CP20528, November 20, 1968, as amended, the “URP") and the East Harlem Triangle Large-Scale Residential Development Plan (the “LSRD"” and together with the URP, the “Historic Zoning_ Restrictions"). The Historic Zoning Restrictions restrict future development of the Property, but allow the Owner's Building to exceed the residential development capacity under the zoning designations currently applicable to the Property. certain Developer's Approvals to Upzone (as such terms are hereinafter defined) the zoning Lot 168 and Lot 165 are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance in excessof10linearfeet. Block 1775,Lots 165 and 168 comprising all or a portion of Lot 168 and/or any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) and to construct other improvements associated with such new building or buildings (said enlargement or new building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “New Building"; Developer’s Building, the New Building and any and all building and improvements now or hereafter located on Lot 168 and/or any Additional Parcels,hereinafter referred to collectively as“Developer's Parcel) which New Building will contain more Development Rights than would be permitted on Lot 168 if considered as a single zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). To effectuate the transfer of Development Rights fromLot165 toLot168and to enable Developer to construct the New Building,AK Beneficial Owner has identified Lot 168 and Lot 165 as a single zoning lot, as stated in the Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement, dated May 11, 2018 and recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York,NewYork County at CRFN 2018000162417("Combined Zoning Lot"). To achieve these objectives, AK Owner wishes to declare for the purpose of establishing and setting forth the rights and obligations of the Parties (hereafter defined) to this Declaration with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, as the same may be further enlarged or subdivided pursuant to the terms of this Declaration, and wish to provide to the maximum extent or action from the other. All references to Additional Parcels shall be deemed to refer to any one Additional Parcel or any combination of such Additional Parcels that Developer elects to includein the Combined ZoningLot.
